newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sunshine in France adds to drought worries.
newsitem.headline: Sunshine in France adds to drought worries.

text.p: Clear skies over all of France on Thursday and spring temperatures added to concerns caused by a long drought and forecasters predicted even warmer weather for Friday.
"The forecast is cloudless weather today and more of the same tomorrow. There is no risk of rain," a Meteo France forecaster said.
"The temperatures are back to normal for spring after a colder snap. They will be above 20 degrees (C), and up to 27/28 in the south-west from this afternoon and probably higher tomorrow," he said.
A string of rainy days recently has given crops a good watering but has not been heavy enough to replenish depleted water tables.
